title: Publish refuses three unpublished commits whose backlog item files hold planted test passwords that the stricter url-password scan now flags, so nothing reaches the public home
goal: the two planted url-password test values in the item files of BG-pwhlp2sy and BG-sa4pmxsl (commits 20b110b4d852, 8019a30bab3c, 1dced285d9a9) are reviewed secret exceptions in _tools/tests_allowlist.txt with a reason naming the planted test, so publish --dry-run refuses no commit for them

run:
import sys,subprocess as s
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import kbcommon as kc, kbpublic as k
allow=k.parse_allowlist(open(k.ALLOWLIST_PATH,encoding='utf-8').read()).get('secret',set())
bad=[]
for c,p in [('20b110b4d852','kb/_self/backlog/BG-pwhlp2sy.json'),('8019a30bab3c','kb/_self/backlog/BG-pwhlp2sy.json'),('1dced285d9a9','kb/_self/backlog/BG-sa4pmxsl.json')]:
    t=s.run(['git','show',c+':'+p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    bad+=[c for kind,v in kc.leak_hits(t) if kind=='secret' and v.lower() not in allow]
print('unpublished commits publish refuses for a planted test value:',sorted(set(bad)))
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
